hypothesised_pattern: The target is underpredicted when x2 and x5 have the same sign and |x4| is large, and overpredicted when x2 and x5 have opposite signs and x4 is small.
rationale: All six positive-residual rows (targets 0.54-0.87) have x2*x5 > 0 (about 0.46 to 1.94) and |x4| of at least 1.03, with x4 ranging from -2.914 to +2.962. All four negative-residual rows (targets 0.19-0.34) have x2*x5 < 0 (about -0.54 to -1.56) and |x4| of at most 0.25, which is consistent with a missing bilinear term plus an even x4 term.
